presentation.label: QPERF
presentation.summary: Set performance locks by holding QPER and turning knobs, clear them, or apply them to the kit.
presentation.overview: Hold QPER and turn a knob: it edits that parameter's offset across every performance linked to QPER, split evenly so together they reach it at full QPER, and the knob inverts and shows the total as it does for a held performance pad. QPER + PLAY clears the linked performances. QPER + YES writes what they add, at the QPER knob's position, into the kit and keeps the locks.
highlights: Sets a lock in every linked performance with one turn
QPER + PLAY clears all linked performances
QPER + YES applies them to the kit
usage: Link performances with QPER + pads, hold QPER and turn knobs to shape one macro on the QPER knob.
Sweep the QPER knob, then QPER + YES when a sound is worth keeping.

access.location: The QPER key, on any page.
steps: Hold QPER and press pads to link performances, as on stock.
Keep QPER held and turn a knob to set its offset.
QPER + PLAY clears the linked performances; press PLAY again to undo.
QPER + YES applies them to the kit.

limitations: QPER + YES skips FX track locks.
Until the QPER knob moves after power on, QPER + YES uses the amounts stock holds.
Replaces stock's QPER + PLAY, which starts the sequencer.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.

tests.summary: Emulator only, not tested on hardware.
